leaves.name: receipts-probe-front

leaves.name: receipts-probe-poll-spacing
leaves.replaces: e3_native41_autoarm_box.Poller.run: a second NativeRuntimeClient reading status every 0.25 s (0.02 s once the shrinking tail stages are in flight) on its own thread
leaves.equivalence: The probe feeds the same compact() views through the same Poller.keep dedup into the same receipt_proof; one read per Core step is the densest spacing the box poller can reach. The thread, the spacing and the loopback client are exercised by the Arm test over HTTP.
leaves.cannot_prove: That a 0.25 s box spacing observes every native chunk (the proof needs only the last chunk and the engagement, each seconds long at box scale; the probe checks every chunk).

leaves.name: queue-argparse-capture
leaves.replaces: argparse.ArgumentParser.parse_args, wrapped so that each module main stops right after parsing its argv
leaves.equivalence: The original parse_args runs on the exact expanded body argv with each module's own parser (e3_native41_autoarm_box, e3_native39_trunk_checks); only its return is raised as Parsed, so main never performs the step (no HTTP, docker or file I/O).

leaves.name: tp-skew-completion
leaves.replaces: CUDA event completion timing of each rank's streams (the r4 ControllableEvent query answer), in the connected auto cycle
leaves.equivalence: A real CUDA event completes in stream order and asynchronously to the host, and an event recorded on an idle stream completes at once. The leaf completes each rank's recorded events in order at a fixed per-rank rate after every Core tick and, with probability 1/2, before each per-rank submit/poll/release delivery of one round; an event recorded while every earlier event on its bus is complete completes at record with probability 1/2 (ControllableEvent.record). Startup, Core, scheduler, auto-arm policy, driver, bridges, dispatchers, RPC schema and validators are the real ones; the probe only counts STATE_FINALIZE agreements around the real driver._apply_segments call.
leaves.cannot_prove: GPU timings, the box frequency of the skew, NCCL collectives, device memory or model exactness.

leaves.name: tp-skew-network
leaves.replaces: CUDA event/stream completion on the four ranks and the stage-0 model's PP last-stage flag in the connected ProfileNetwork composition
leaves.equivalence: Real NativeSegmentDriver, NativeWorkerBridge, LaneDispatcher, QsaLayerDriver and QsaPrefillOperation on stage 0 (r4 lanes on stage 1), as in test_e3_native_schedule_profile. Completion is controlled per rank (held events stay incomplete; ControllableEvent.record completes an event recorded on an idle stream, as a GPU does). _flash_e3_is_last_stage is False on stage 0, which the real stage-0 model of a two-stage pipeline is. Test wrappers observe bridge.submit and driver._apply_segments and call the real methods; the divergence cases replace one accepted reply's cursor or pause to prove the agreement still refuses.
leaves.cannot_prove: GPU timings, NCCL collectives, real TP o_proj, the dense box route, model exactness.
